stem.en: Waves have cut caves and arches from a headland. Which of these do they build, and from what?

text.en: A sea stack, from sand the waves drop

feedback.en: No. A stack is rock left behind after the top of an arch falls.

text.en: A blow hole, from sand the waves drop

feedback.en: No. A blow hole is cut, not built.

text.en: A beach, from sand the waves drop

feedback.en: Yes. A beach is a depositional feature.

text.en: A stump, from sand the waves drop

feedback.en: No. A stump is what remains of a worn-down stack.

explanation.en: A wave that slows down drops the sand and pebbles it was carrying, and the pile becomes a beach. Stacks, stumps and blow holes are what is left after the sea has cut rock away.

hints.en: Which of these is made by adding material, not removing it?
